statement.title: Statement
statement.description: One fact needed to answer the question: the figure, its unit and fiscal period.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: The sentence or table row of the document the fact comes from, verbatim.

page.title: Page
page.description: The page number of the quote, from the page markers in the document.

sites.header:
Extractor.extract(document: str, question: str) -> list[Fact] --- List every fact from `document` needed to answer `question`: the figures with their units and fiscal periods, each quoted from the document with its page. Do not compute and do not answer.
      document: str ---- The relevant pages of the filing.
      question: str ---- The question to be answered.

bindings.name: self
bindings.label: self =
bindings.tail: ---- Reads the filing pages and pulls out the facts the question needs.

sites.system_prompt: This is a task you must complete by returning only the output. The task will be expressed in the form of function call with arguments. Do not include explanations, code, or extra text—only the result.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: The computation or comparison performed on the facts, step by step.

result.title: Result
result.description: The resulting value or conclusion, with its unit.

sites.header:
Analyst.compute(document: str, question: str, facts: list[Fact]) -> Analysis --- Using `facts` and, where a fact is missing, `document`, perform the computation or comparison `question` asks for. Show every step with its figures. State the result with its unit.
      document: str ---- The relevant pages of the filing.
      question: str ---- The question to be answered.
      facts: list[Fact] ---- The facts the extractor found, in document order.
          - statement: str ---- One fact needed to answer the question: the figure, its unit and fiscal period.
          - quote: str ---- The sentence or table row of the document the fact comes from, verbatim.
          - page: int ---- The page number of the quote, from the page markers in the document.
sites.hint:
Schema requirements:
- reasoning (string) -- The computation or comparison performed on the facts, step by step.
- result (string) -- The resulting value or conclusion, with its unit.

bindings.name: self
bindings.label: self =
bindings.tail: ---- Derives the answer from the extracted facts.

sites.system_prompt: This is a task you must complete by returning only the output. The task will be expressed in the form of function call with arguments. Do not include explanations, code, or extra text—only the result.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether every fact is faithful to the document and the analysis follows from the facts.

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Each discrepancy found, or empty when the analysis holds.

sites.header:
Auditor.check(document: str, question: str, facts: list[Fact], analysis: Analysis) -> Audit --- Verify each of `facts` against `document` and verify that `analysis` answers `question` from those facts without arithmetic or unit errors. Report every discrepancy.
      document: str ---- The relevant pages of the filing.
      question: str ---- The question to be answered.
      facts: list[Fact] ---- The facts the extractor found.
          - statement: str ---- One fact needed to answer the question: the figure, its unit and fiscal period.
          - quote: str ---- The sentence or table row of the document the fact comes from, verbatim.
          - page: int ---- The page number of the quote, from the page markers in the document.
      analysis: Analysis ---- The analyst's computation and result.
          - reasoning: str ---- The computation or comparison performed on the facts, step by step.
          - result: str ---- The resulting value or conclusion, with its unit.
sites.hint:
Schema requirements:
- passed (boolean) -- Whether every fact is faithful to the document and the analysis follows from the facts.
- issues (array) -- Each discrepancy found, or empty when the analysis holds.

bindings.name: self
bindings.label: self =
bindings.tail: ---- Checks the facts against the filing and the analysis against the facts.

sites.system_prompt: This is a task you must complete by returning only the output. The task will be expressed in the form of function call with arguments. Do not include explanations, code, or extra text—only the result.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: The final answer: a number with its unit, or a short phrase.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: One paragraph justifying the answer from the facts.

sites.header:
Writer.answer(question: str, facts: list[Fact], analysis: Analysis, audit: Audit) -> Answer --- Answer `question` from `facts` and `analysis`. If `audit` reports issues, correct the answer accordingly. Give the number with its unit, or the phrase the question asks for.
      question: str ---- The question to be answered.
      facts: list[Fact] ---- The facts the extractor found.
          - statement: str ---- One fact needed to answer the question: the figure, its unit and fiscal period.
          - quote: str ---- The sentence or table row of the document the fact comes from, verbatim.
          - page: int ---- The page number of the quote, from the page markers in the document.
      analysis: Analysis ---- The analyst's computation and result.
          - reasoning: str ---- The computation or comparison performed on the facts, step by step.
          - result: str ---- The resulting value or conclusion, with its unit.
      audit: Audit ---- The auditor's verdict and issues.
          - passed: bool ---- Whether every fact is faithful to the document and the analysis follows from the facts.
          - issues: list ---- Each discrepancy found, or empty when the analysis holds.
sites.hint:
Schema requirements:
- answer (string) -- The final answer: a number with its unit, or a short phrase.
- rationale (string) -- One paragraph justifying the answer from the facts.
